subject: FY23 School Operating Budget Review
overview: The School Committee held a special budget meeting to review priorities for the FY23 operating budget, including vocational program expansion, elementary enrollment trends, professional learning, and operational costs. No formal votes were taken on the budget figures.

items.title: Superintendent and Administration FY23 Budget Overview
items.summary: David Murphy presented an overview of the developing FY23 budget, outlining collective bargaining wage pressures, fixed cost projections of approximately $69.9 million, and the alignment of spending proposals with the strategic plan.

items.title: Vocational School Program and Budget Requests
items.summary: Chad Fallon detailed increasing CTE enrollment, recent grant-funded equipment acquisitions, and budget requests for two additional instructor positions and a $75,000 supply increase.

items.title: Elementary Enrollment Trends and Potential Class Consolidations
items.summary: Suzanne Galusi presented K-4 general education enrollment figures and outlined potential consolidations of under-enrolled classrooms at the McGlynn and Missituk elementary schools.

items.title: Curriculum, Literacy Initiatives, and Professional Learning Plans
items.summary: Suzanne Galusi and Dr. Cushing outlined elementary literacy planning with Hill for Literacy, the shift to DIBELS and science of reading practices, and district-wide professional development priorities for FY23.

items.title: Operations, Maintenance, and Capital Budget Items
items.summary: David Murphy reviewed anticipated fixed cost increases in software subscriptions and utilities, and previewed capital repair priorities including high school facilities and McGlynn building leaks.

items.title: Budget Process Deliberation and Next Steps
items.summary: The committee and administration discussed the timeline for finalizing categorical requests, releasing the draft budget book, and holding a statutory public hearing.
